tasks.title: Scaffold project with all deps, tooling, and agent
tasks.description: Initialize Bun project with Next.js, install ALL dependencies (Electron, Three.js, Zustand, Tailwind v4, Biome), configure all tooling, set up base project structure, and create agent.md with complete stack documentation.
tasks.action:
1. Initialize project: Run `bun create vite iris-desktop-companion --template react-ts` if not exists, otherwise use existing structure. 2. Install ALL dependencies: - Runtime: `bun add electron@^33.2.0 electron-updater@^6.3.9 react@^19.0.0 react-dom@^19.0.0 zustand@^5.0.2` - Dev: `bun add -d @biomejs/biome@^1.9.4 @types/node@^22.10.2 @types/react@^19.0.0 @types/react-dom@^19.0.0 @vitejs/plugin-react@^4.3.4 electron-builder@^25.1.8 typescript@^5.7.2 vite@^6.0.5 vite-plugin-electron@^0.28.9 vite-plugin-electron-renderer@^0.14.6 tailwindcss@^4.0.0` 3. Configure vite.config.ts: ```ts import { defineConfig } from 'vite'; import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'; import electron from 'vite-plugin-electron'; import renderer from 'vite-plugin-electron-renderer'; export default defineConfig({ plugins: [ react(), electron([ { entry: 'electron/main.ts', vite: { build: { outDir: 'dist-electron' } } }, { entry: 'electron/preload.ts', onstart(options) { options.reload(); }, vite: { build: { outDir: 'dist-electron' } } }, ]), renderer(), ], }); ``` 4. Configure tsconfig.json (strict mode, path aliases): ```json { "compilerOptions": { "target": "ES2020", "useDefineForClassFields": true, "lib": ["ES2020", "DOM", "DOM.Iterable"], "module": "ESNext", "skipLibCheck": true, "moduleResolution": "bundler", "allowImportingTsExtensions": true, "resolveJsonModule": true, "isolatedModules": true, "noEmit": true, "jsx": "react-jsx", "strict": true, "noUnusedLocals": true, "noUnusedParameters": true, "noFallthroughCasesInSwitch": true, "baseUrl": ".", "paths": { "@/*": ["./src/*"] } }, "include": ["src", "electron"], "references": [{ "path": "./tsconfig.node.json" }] } ``` 5. Configure biome.json: ```json { "$schema": "https://biomejs.dev/schemas/1.9.4/schema.json", "organizeImports": { "enabled": true }, "linter": { "enabled": true, "rules": { "recommended": true } }, "formatter": { "enabled": true, "indentStyle": "space", "indentWidth": 2 } } ``` 6. Configure tailwind.config.ts: ```ts import type { Config } from 'tailwindcss'; export default { content: ['./index.html', './src/**/*.{ts,tsx}'], theme: { extend: { animation: { pulse: 'pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite', spin: 'spin 1s linear infinite', bounce: 'bounce 1s infinite', }, }, }, plugins: [], } satisfies Config; ``` 7. Create index.html with CDN import map: ```html Iris Desktop Companion
``` 8. Create src/index.css: ```css @tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities; body { margin: 0; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; background: transparent; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Roboto', sans-serif; } #root { width: 100vw; height: 100vh; } ``` 9. Create src/main.tsx: ```tsx import React from 'react'; import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client'; import { App } from './App'; import './index.css'; ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!).render( , ); ``` 10. Update package.json scripts and electron-builder config (merge with existing). 11. Create .env.example: ``` VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY= ``` 12. Update .gitignore to include .env, dist, dist-electron, release. 13. **CRITICAL**: Create agent.md: ```md # Iris Desktop Companion Agent ## Project Overview AI-powered VRM desktop companion with real-time voice interaction via Gemini 2.0 Flash. Transparent overlay window that follows cursor across displays. ## Tech Stack (Exact Versions) - **Runtime**: Bun 1.1.38 - **Desktop**: electron@33.2.0, electron-builder@25.1.8, electron-updater@6.3.9 - **Framework**: react@19.0.0, react-dom@19.0.0, vite@6.0.5 - **Language**: typescript@5.7.2 (strict mode) - **3D**: three.js@0.170.0 (CDN), @pixiv/three-vrm@3.1.6 (CDN) - **State**: zustand@5.0.2 - **Styling**: tailwindcss@4.0.0 - **Tooling**: @biomejs/biome@1.9.4, vite-plugin-electron@0.28.9 ## Architecture - `electron/` — Main process (window mgmt, IPC), preload script - `src/` — React renderer (UI, 3D canvas, voice pipeline) - `public/` — Bundled assets (avatar.glb, idle_loop.vrma, icons) - `dist-electron/` — Compiled Electron code - `dist/` — Compiled renderer - `release/` — Packaged executables ## Key Patterns - **Window**: Transparent, click-through, always-on-top (screen-saver level), follows cursor - **3D Loading**: CDN imports via import map (no npm three.js), async VRM loading - **Voice**: WebSocket to Gemini, microphone via getUserMedia, Web Audio API playback - **State**: Zustand for voice status, no persistence - **Components**: Server components N/A (not Next.js), all client-side React ## Import Conventions - Use `@/` alias for src/ (tsconfig paths) - Three.js imports: `import * as THREE from 'three';` (from CDN) - VRM imports: `import { VRM, VRMLoaderPlugin, VRMUtils } from '@pixiv/three-vrm';` - Electron IPC: `window.electron?.ipcRenderer?.send/on` (via preload) ## File Structure - `electron/main.ts` — BrowserWindow config, cursor tracking, global shortcuts - `electron/preload.ts` — Context bridge for IPC - `src/App.tsx` — Root component (mounts AvatarCanvas + UIOverlay) - `src/components/AvatarCanvas.tsx` — Three.js scene, VRM loader - `src/components/UIOverlay.tsx` — Status dots, speech bubbles - `src/services/voice-pipeline.ts` — VoicePipeline singleton - `src/stores/voiceStore.ts` — Zustand voice state - `src/utils/procedural-overlays.ts` — Animation helpers - `src/types/electron.d.ts` — window.electron types ## Environment Variables - `VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY` — Required for voice features ## Commands - `bun run dev` — Start dev server (HMR) - `bun run build` — Build renderer + main - `bun run package` — Package as executable - `bun run lint` — Biome check + fix - `tsc --noEmit` — Type check only ```
tasks.verify: bun run lint && tsc --noEmit && test -f agent.md
tasks.done: All deps installed, configs created, agent.md exists, project builds without errors

tasks.action:
Read agent.md to understand the project stack, dependencies, and conventions. Then:

1. Create public/.gitkeep (assets will be added manually by user):
```
# Placeholder for VRM assets
# Required files:
# - avatar.glb (VRM 1.0 model, ~12MB)
# - idle_loop.vrma (VRM animation, ~500KB)
# - icon.ico (256×256)
# - icon.png (1024×1024)
```

2. Update package.json scripts:
```json
{
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "vite",
    "build": "tsc && vite build",
    "package": "electron-builder --dir",
    "release": "electron-builder --publish always",
    "lint": "biome check --write ./src ./electron"
  },
  "main": "dist-electron/main.js",
  "build": {
    "appId": "com.iris.companion",
    "productName": "Iris",
    "directories": { "output": "release" },
    "files": ["dist/**/*", "dist-electron/**/*", "public/**/*"],
    "win": {
      "target": ["nsis", "portable"],
      "icon": "public/icon.ico"
    },
    "nsis": {
      "oneClick": false,
      "allowToChangeInstallationDirectory": true
    },
    "publish": {
      "provider": "github",
      "owner": "your-username",
      "repo": "iris-companion"
    }
  }
}
```

3. Add README note about assets:
```md
# Iris Desktop Companion

## Setup
1. `bun install`
2. Add VRM assets to `public/` (avatar.glb, idle_loop.vrma)
3. Create `.env` with `VITE_GEMINI_API_KEY=your_key`
4. `bun run dev`
```
